scenes.text: First find the unit rate or scaling factor, then apply that factor consistently to the new situation.
At a fixed rate of 5 items per 3 people, find the items for 9 people. The answer is 15. Both parts scale by 3, so 5 times 3 equals 15.
A class at a science exhibition uses 3 bottles for 3 pupils. At the same rate, how many bottles are needed for 6 pupils? Pause to choose and explain.
A class at a science exhibition uses 3 bottles for 3 pupils. At the same rate, how many bottles are needed for 6 pupils? The answer is 6. Both parts scale by 2, so 3 times 2 equals 6.
